Summary: Aurabound is a mid-market product analytics SaaS building a conversational product assistant and semantic search for their B2B product. They started on Redwood Hosted API (Q1 POC) and are now negotiating Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latency and cost.

Key requirements and constraints:
- Workloads: chat (customer support assistant), embeddings for in-app doc search, reranking for relevance pipelines. Rerank workload is bursty during daily syncs.
- Latency targets: p95 generation <= 120ms for 256-token responses on chat; tail latency for reranking must be < 80ms for single-document scores.
- Throughput: steady-state 20-35 QPS for embeddings/rerank; peak burst upto 120 QPS for rerank during index rebuild windows.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market ARR target; wants committed pricing to control unit cost. Looking for predictable monthly vGPU-hour commit with discounted overage.
- Model preferences: prefer 13B-class open model variants; fallback path to quantized 7B for cost-sensitive routes. Need Redwood to guarantee compatible fallback and model pinning.
- Deployment: must keep customer PII and logs within NA, prefer VPC/private deployment for Dedicated; hosted API used for evaluation only.
- Security: SOC2 compliant, SSO (SAML) for console, audit logging with 12-month retention, KMS integration for key management. Data residency (US) required.
